text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent
text_block_list.text:
Eat up as much as you like, you two! Don't 
worry about helping out~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Staying active suits me better anyway.

On the way back from our outing. Some 
children I recognized called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Lively Girl
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! It's the hero big sisters who 
saved Doto-oneechan!
choice_data_list:
Ah, that was when we covered the legendary 
sword...

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent A
text_block_list.text:
My, my! I've heard all about it. It seems 
Opera O-san's play was completed thanks to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent B
text_block_list.text:
They seemed so excited and eager to see 
them. Would you like to join us for a 
barbecue if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, I really didn't do much, so—

text_block_list.name: Cheeky Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on! Just a little bit! 
Pretty please! Here, this way, this way!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hey!

And so, we joined the barbecue, but Admire 
Vega still seemed to be holding back...

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh? We're out of ingredients 
already. Maybe I should go buy some more.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ! ...In that case, I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, no, stay seated! You're a guest, and 
there's gonna be a lot to carry!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I shouldn't have forgotten anything, 
hopefully. ............"

Cardboard boxes piled high. Even if one 
had the strength to lift them, carrying 
them while maintaining balance would 
surely be impossible.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm in a bit of a bind, but... since I 
said it myself—"

Huh, Ayabe-san! Whoa, isn't that a ton of 
luggage?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! This is the delivery 
destination, right? Let's get them off the 
cart then!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. Um... you really helped me 
out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem at all! I was planning to 
buy a lot today anyway, so I brought a 
handcart with me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm sure they had things to do too. I 
really made them go out of their way...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...After all the time and effort they 
spent... Is just a "thank you" really 
enough...?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be off! Have fun, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh... W-Wait!

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! You're going to wait! I 
have to treat you to a meal to thank you 
for carrying everything♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure?! In that case... thank 
you very much. I'll gladly partake!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I'm so very happy for the thought!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Feelings...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No need. I've already received your thanks 
in words.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But wait, that alone isn't... Ah! How 
about something besides drinks~? Like ice 
cream, or grilled carrots! And—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...I see.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Top Road-san. I'll do the grilling. 
Please, just sit and wait.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: What's wrong? You seem lost in thought.

What's wrong? You look like you're lost in 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel like I understand a little how 
Doto felt back then."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A feeling that goes beyond mere words of 
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...A sensation that words can't capture. 
She said that exists, too.
choice_data_list: Then, we gotta grill it to perfection!

Then, we'll have to grill it to 
perfection!
It was a day full of learning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...A sensation that words can't capture. 
She said that exists, too.
choice_data_list: Then, we gotta grill it to perfection!

Then, we'll have to grill it to 
perfection!
It was a day full of learning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure you don't burn yourself out 
either.

text_block_list.name: Children's Club Parent
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Thanks so much, you two. I'll grill 
up some delicious meat for both of you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
……It's a bit embarrassing to say out loud 
now, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your unsolicited fussing. 
Just shut up and eat.

Admire Vega kept piling freshly grilled 
meat and vegetables onto my plate, one 
after another, without even giving me a 
chance to get a word in.
